name: Invisiline Monofilament Fishing Line
description: Engineered with advanced copolymer structures, Lucana Invisiline matches the refractive index of water, becoming completely invisible under the surface. It provides excellent knot security and shock-absorbing stretch.
features: A refractive index close to water renders the line nearly invisible to cautious fish
Superb knot strength and easy tying properties
Controlled structural elasticity provides a shock buffer for heavy strikes

name: Stealth Braid 8X Fishing Line
description: Woven with eight strands of high-grade Japanese UHMWPE fibers, the Stealth Braid 8X has a perfectly round, ultra-smooth profile. It glides through guides silently and has virtually zero stretch for instant hooksets.
features: 8-strand weave creates a perfectly round cross-section that casts further
High abrasion resistance makes it perfect for heavy wood and rock cover
Zero stretch delivers phenomenal sensitivity and immediate hook penetration

name: Ocean Pro Fluorocarbon Line
description: Our premium fluorocarbon leader material is 100% PVDF. Formulated for ultimate abrasion resistance, it sinks faster than standard nylon and is practically indestructible against sharp reef rocks and fish teeth.
features: High-density formulation sinks five times faster than standard monofilament
Incredible surface hardness withstands razor-sharp teeth and barnacles
Comes on a compact, tangle-free dispenser spool

name: Phantom Braid Ultra-Thin Line
description: An incredibly thin, multi-carrier braid tailored for micro-finesse casting. With a diameter equivalent to 1lb nylon, it enables extreme throwing distance with 1/32oz jigheads while retaining a 10lb breaking limit.
features: Microscopic 0.08mm profile minimizes surface friction for legendary casting distances
High-vis chartreuse color allows effortless line monitoring for soft stream ticks
Highly coated surface reduces wind-knot nesting

name: Tournament Braid Blue Water Line
description: A heavy-duty high-visibility blue braided line crafted for massive offshore trolling and jigging reels. Colored with UV-resistant pigments to prevent fading in intense marine environments.
features: 9-strand weave adds an extra stabilizing core strand for zero collapsing flat
UV guard treatment maintains fiber integrity under hours of salt sun
Color-metered every 100 yards to accurately gauge lure depth distance
